about: Every judge ships with at least one wrong implementation or wrong file it must fail, in CI (v3 plan rule; Loom laws 19 and 44). Code plants copy source/ and make one edit; file plants are fixtures under tests/plants/.

roughness-dropped.what: the X3D 4.0 writer stops writing PhysicalMaterial roughness (a silent loss of a carried property)

spot-blend-carried.what: the writer starts deriving beamWidth from spot_blend while the table still says dropped (a stale row) and the receipt still names it

receipt-forgets-clamp.what: the receipt stops reporting clamped values (rules of kind gt never fire)
receipt-forgets-clamp.find: return number is not None and number > float(rule["value"]) + 1e-9

roughness-dropped-golden.what: the same roughness-dropped edit, judged by the golden files instead of the sweep

translation-axes-swapped.what: the writer swaps a Transform's Y and Z translation (every scene still exports and validates)
translation-axes-swapped.replace: tx, tz, ty = instance.transform.translation  # PLANTED FAULT translation-axes-swapped

basecolour-channels-swapped.what: the writer swaps red and blue of every PhysicalMaterial baseColor (valid X3D; only a picture shows it)
